questions.question_text: Which of the following statement(s) are true about lexical analysis in a compiler?
questions.question_html: Which of the following statement(s) are true about lexical analysis in a compiler?

A.text: A.It uses regular expressions to define the patterns of valid tokens.
A.html: It uses regular expressions to define the patterns of valid tokens.

B.text: B.It detects syntax error in source code.
B.html: It detects syntax error in source code.

C.text: C.It eliminates white space and expand macros in the source code.
C.html: It eliminates white space and expand macros in the source code.

D.text: D.It convert code into meaningful sequence of characters.
D.html: It convert code into meaningful sequence of characters.

questions.solution_text:
Solution
(a, d)
(a) Token pattern are defined using regular expressions.
(b) Syntactic errors are handled in the syntax analysis phase not by the lexical phase.
(c) Lexer removes white space but macro expansion done by preprocessor.
(d) Lexical analysis turns the character stream into meaning tokens (line = int, a = etc.).
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(a, d)
(a) Token pattern are defined using regular expressions.
(b) Syntactic errors are handled in the syntax analysis phase not by the lexical phase.
(c) Lexer removes white space but macro expansion done by preprocessor.
(d) Lexical analysis turns the character stream into meaning tokens (line = int, a = etc.).

S

: A basic block is a sequence of instruction with only one entry and one exit point.

questions.question_html:
Consider the following statements about a basic block in a compiler:
S1 : A basic block contains no conditional or unconditional jump instruction.
S2 : A basic block may have multiple entry points but only one exit point.
S3 : A basic block is a sequence of instruction with only one entry and one exit point.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.solution_text:
Solution
(a)
S
1
: False: Because a basic block can contain jumps. It just can’t have jumps into the middle of it.
S
2
: False: A basic block has only one entry and exit point and no branches except at the end.
S
3
: True: Standard definition of basic block.
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(a)
S1 : False: Because a basic block can contain jumps. It just can’t have jumps into the middle of it.
S2 : False: A basic block has only one entry and exit point and no branches except at the end.
S3 : True: Standard definition of basic block.
